title: RAW UNREVIEWED: ingredient-centred and complaint-centred chapters preserve reciprocal indication statements
summary: A compiler writes the same medical recommendations in two organizations: entries headed by a preparation enumerate complaints; entries headed by a complaint enumerate preparations. This is a hypothesis about book production, not a claim that Voynich sections are such indices. RAW_UNREVIEWED; no target reading or word assignment.

design.access: Existing route, topic and bounded registry navigation only. No target payload, new images, reserves, fits or new source acquisitions in this pass.
design.claim_ceiling: A proposed authoring mechanism, not a manuscript finding or historical attestation. No Voynich form receives a meaning. A confirmed word is not required to draft the hypothesis; candidate word assignments nevertheless require profiles and complete prior counterexamples before use.
design.positive_structure: Reusable directed composition, hierarchical spaces, whole-form residuals and entry effects; adjacency transfer across sections/hands with weaker transfer of direction; known r/l phrase transfer but failure on new stem combinations. These are structural observations, not semantic support for this proposal.
design.retained_failures: GDT915 mixed cells and GDT916 new-stem failure, W89 recipe pause, GDT1153 fixed anaphora failure, GDT1163 correlative failure, GDT1164/1166 writing-channel failures and partial f38v whole-chain draft remain unchanged. No f38v restart or control repair.
design.mechanism: A compiler writes the same medical recommendations in two organizations: entries headed by a preparation enumerate complaints; entries headed by a complaint enumerate preparations. This is a hypothesis about book production, not a claim that Voynich sections are such indices.
design.complete_content_construction: Preparation A is recommended for X under condition C but not for Y under C; preparation B is recommended for Y under D. Complaint-centred retelling must give X: A under C, and Y: B under D while retaining the exclusion of A under C. Preparation steps may occur only in the preparation entry and must remain explicit unmatched content, not be discarded.
design.finite_consequence: Transpose the directed indication relation while preserving condition, polarity and participant identity. A relation copied as bare co-occurrence, or an identity/synonym relation, predicts a different reciprocal clause and cannot erase the conditional exclusion.
design.authoring_step: Nominate two complete previously admitted multi-entry blocks with different structural registers from existing reports, then draft a common recommendation inventory and both full redactions jointly. Pay all lexical identities and unmatched clauses. Begin with exactly two preparations, two complaints and two conditions as a bounded exploratory content object; these counts are a model budget, not a Voynich claim.
design.frequency_obligation: High-frequency forms are candidates only for the reusable relation, conditions or reference machinery after profiling; preparation and complaint identities are not allocated merely by theme or local images.
design.difference: Cross-index reciprocal propositions preserve polarity and conditions, beyond graph adjacency, within-row header inheritance or synonym equality. A whole account can be drafted before any entity is historically named.
design.likely_failure: The manuscript may not contain reciprocal indices; approximate matching could manufacture them. Entity permutations remain and a successful relational fit would not establish any plant name. No control using gold complaint labels is proposed.
